CustomField.description: Used to identify records with a un-masked email address.
CustomField.formula: /* WHERE ( ( Email != null ) AND ( NOT Email LIKE '%.invalid' ) AND ( Email != 'preprod_emails@insperity.com' ) AND ( ( Email LIKE '%@insperity.com' ) OR ( NOT Email LIKE '%@insperity.%' ) ) ) */ OR( AND( NOT( ISBLANK( Email ) ) , NOT( RIGHT( Email , 8 ) = '.invalid' ) , NOT( Email = 'preprod_emails@insperity.com' ) , OR( ( RIGHT( Email , 14 ) = '@insperity.com' ), NOT( CONTAINS( Email , '@insperity.' ) ) ) ) , AND( NOT( ISBLANK( NSP_Alt_Email__c ) ) , NOT( RIGHT( NSP_Alt_Email__c , 8 ) = '.invalid' ) , NOT( NSP_Alt_Email__c = 'preprod_emails@insperity.com' ) , OR( ( RIGHT( NSP_Alt_Email__c , 14 ) = '@insperity.com' ), NOT( CONTAINS( NSP_Alt_Email__c , '@insperity.' ) ) ) ) , AND( NOT( ISBLANK( NSP_Personal_Email__c ) ) , NOT( RIGHT( NSP_Personal_Email__c , 8 ) = '.invalid' ) , NOT( NSP_Personal_Email__c = 'preprod_emails@insperity.com' ) , OR( ( RIGHT( NSP_Personal_Email__c , 14 ) = '@insperity.com' ), NOT( CONTAINS( NSP_Personal_Email__c , '@insperity.' ) ) ) ) , AND( NOT( ISBLANK( NSP_Work_email__c ) ) , NOT( RIGHT( NSP_Work_email__c , 8 ) = '.invalid' ) , NOT( NSP_Work_email__c = 'preprod_emails@insperity.com' ) , OR( ( RIGHT( NSP_Work_email__c , 14 ) = '@insperity.com' ), NOT( CONTAINS( NSP_Work_email__c , '@insperity.' ) ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Has Unmasked Email
